sentences.text: The Tidal Current Tables are built just like the Tide Tables, so this will feel familiar.
Table one gives the daily times of slack water and maximum current at the reference stations, with the maximum flood and ebb speeds.
Table two is for the subordinate stations.
It gives time differences, speed ratios for flood and ebb, and the true directions of flood and ebb.
Table three gives the speed at any time between slack and maximum.
The reference station predicts a maximum flood of two knots at fourteen hundred.
Your subordinate station has a time difference of minus twenty minutes, and a flood ratio of point six.
When is your maximum flood, and how strong?
Thirteen forty, and two times point six is one point two knots.
